Connect to GitHub

Paste a GitHub personal access token with write access to this repo, and new lines you load into the page will be committed straight to GitHub automatically — no more manual download-and-upload. The token is kept only in this browser (in localStorage); it is never written into the page itself or into what gets committed.

Add a new transcribed line

Upload the manuscript photo and/or the hieroglyphic transcription image for one line, then load it into the page below. If you've connected GitHub above, it's committed automatically — otherwise use “Download updated page” to save a wenamun.html you can upload yourself.
